metadata.title: Why the AI agent craze could give Intel a boost - MarketWatch

content.text:
5 hours ago
Why the AI agent craze could give Intel a boost
Over the last several weeks, artificial-intelligence agents like Meta's Muse have exploded in popularity. That could give Intel a boost, according to RBC analyst Srini Pajjuri.
"Looking ahead, Intel should continue to benefit from agentic AI-driven demand" for server central processing units, or CPUs, the analyst said in an Oct. 25 note to clients. That said, Pajjuri also noted that the opportunity could be limited by competition from Arm and Advanced Micro Devices.
TD Cowen analysts led by Joshua Buchalter also wrote in a recent note that CPUs are seeing a "resurgence" driven by AI agents, which led him to modestly raise estimates for both Intel and Arm.
